sam_sales: Escalation: Meridian Health procurement stalled. They want guarantee of tenant isolation + KMS key residency. CFO wants answers before EOD or they pause contract. Need legal + infra help.
neha_se: Quick: Dedicated provides isolated GPU pools; Private supports customer VPC and key residency. We can offer a Dedicated pilot with IP allowlist + RBAC but cant promise KMS key residency on Dedicated.
tom_pm: Proposal: 30-day Dedicated pilot with written conversion path to Private (60 days). Include SLA for uptime and audit exports.
rachel_legal: I need their exact asks in writing (which systems/data are in scope, retention, who gets access). I can draft a limited amendment for the pilot that preserves our standard DPA.
diego_ops: Ops can enable RBAC and disable console + provide syslog export to their SIEM. Need 5 business days to stand up the pilot if infra prioritized.
olivia_cto: Exec-level: offer pilot + 2 months premium support credits and a CEO note to their CIO to smooth procurement. We should avoid promising key residency on Dedicated; only on Private.
sam_sales: Draft email to CIO for quick review: 
"Hi [CIO], to unblock procurement we propose a 30-day Dedicated pilot (isolated compute, RBAC, audit export). If pilot satisfies security, we commit to Private deployment with key residency within 60 days. Can you confirm: data classes, required principals, mandatory KMS/HSM?"
neha_se: I'll produce RBAC matrix and KMS integration note by tomorrow EOD.
rachel_legal: Once they confirm the short list, Ill circulate pilot amendment redlines.
diego_ops: Created ticket OPS-3219 and attached runbook + pricing uplift. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-3219
alertbot: Calendar invite: Meridian CIO sync  2026-06-12 16:00 PT.
sam_sales: Update after CIO call: CIO agreed to pilot if legal signs amendment and we can show audit exports into their Splunk. They also insisted on no vendor console shells. Moving to actionables.
